versions.changelog:
Initial release of mcp-apps-host-dev skill, focused on MCP Apps Host layer development and debugging.

- Provides a reference guide for implementing and troubleshooting MCP Apps host logic, including sandboxed card rendering, message bridging, and security in any agent application.
- Covers the full bridge architecture, data flow, security model, common host-side pitfalls, and role/file mapping using Hermes Desktop as an example.
- Details implementation roles, card rendering pipeline, and when/how to use (and not use) this skill.
- Explains forms of card delivery, handshake protocols, caching, and integration points.
- Includes comprehensive architecture diagrams and reference code mapping for real-world host implementations.
